# youtrack_project_custom_field (Resource)

Attaches a custom field to a project. Destroying this resource removes the field and its values from all issues of the project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "youtrack_project_custom_field" "customer" {
  project_id       = youtrack_project.support.id
  field_id         = youtrack_custom_field.customer.id
  bundle_id        = youtrack_enum_bundle.customers.id
  can_be_empty     = true
  empty_field_text = "No customer"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `field_id` (String) Database ID of the custom field prototype.
- `project_id` (String) Database ID of the project.

### Optional

- `bundle_id` (String) Database ID of the bundle with the values of the field. Only for enum, state, build, version, owned and user fields. Defaults to the bundle chosen by YouTrack.
- `can_be_empty` (Boolean) Whether the field can be empty.
- `empty_field_text` (String) Text shown when the field is empty.
- `is_public` (Boolean) Whether the field is visible to users without the permission to read private fields.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Database ID of the project custom field.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import youtrack_project_custom_field.customer 0-29/147-339
```
